title: Recommendations of halt at Masha'rul Haraam
categoryChain: Recommendations of halt at Masha'rul Haraam
introduction:
RECOMMENDATIONS OF HALT AT MASHA'RUL HARAAM

It is recommended to go to Masha'rul Haraam from Arafaat with a serene body and heart and seek repentance on the way. Upon reaching the red mound from the right one should say:

I. Sadiq (a) says: "Walk with moderation and do not hurt anyone. It is recommended to delay Maghrib and Isha prayers till one reaches Muzdalifah and one third night passes away. Perform both the prayers with single Azaan and Eqaamat and perform the Nawafils of Maghrib after Isha prayers. If there is some obstacle on the way before half night then he should not delay prayers and perform them on the way itself."

It is recommended to enter in the middle of valley from the right. If a pilgrim is performing Hajj for a first time then it is recommended to get down at Masha'rul Haraama and spent the night in Allah's worship as much as possible and recite this supplication:

I. Sadiq (a) says :It is recommended to praise and glorify Allah after Morning prayers in a clean condition. One should invoke about the bounties and excellence of Allah as much as possible. He should pray to Allah and recite this supplication:

On should bring seventy pebbles to be thrown in Mina from Muzdalifah itself. It is recommended while coming towards Mina from Muzdalifah one should walk a distance of about hundred steps fast like a camel upon reaching the valley of Muhassar. Recitation of this supplication is recommended:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْ تَوَقُّفِیْ وَ زِدْهُ فِیْ عَمَلِیْ وَ سَلِّمْ دِیْنِیْ وَ تَقَبَّلْ مَنَاسِكِیْ۔

اَللّٰهُمَّ هٰذِهٖ جُمَعُ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تَجْمَعَ لِیْ فِیْهَا جَوَامِعَ الْخَیْرِ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تُؤْیِسْنِیْ مِنَ الْخَیْرِ الَّذِیْ سَاَلْتُكَ اَنْ تَجْمَعَهٗ لِیْ فِیْ قَلْبِیْ وَ اَطْلُبُ اِلَیْكَ اَنْ تُعَرِّفَنِیْ مَا عَرَّفْتَ اَوْلِیَآئَكَ فِیْ مَنْزِلِیْ هٰذَا اَنْ تَقِیَنِیْ جَوَامِعَ الشَّرِّ۔

اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ فُكَّ رَقَبَتِیْ مِنَ النَّارِ وَ اَوْسِعْ عَلَیَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ الْحَلَالِ وَ ادْرَا عَنِّیْ شَرَّ فَسَقَۃِ الْجِنِّ وَ الْاِنْسِ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ خَیْرُ مَطْلُوْبٍ اِلَیْهِ وَ خَیْرُ مَدْعُوٍّ وَ خَیْرُ مَسْؤُوْلٍ وَ لِكُلِّ وَافِدٍ جَائِزَۃً فَاجْعَلْ جَائِزَتِیْ فِیْ مَوْطِنِیْ هٰذَا اَنْ تُقِیْلَنِیْ عَثْرَتِیْ وَ تَقْبَلَ مَعْذِرَتِیْ وَ اَنْ تُجَاوِزَ عَنْ خَطِیْٓئَتِیْ ثُمَّ اجْعَلِ التَّقْوٰی مِنَ الدُّنْیَا زَادِیْ۔
اَللّٰهُمَّ سَلِّمْ لِیْ عَهْدِیْ وَ اقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِیْ وَ اَجِبْ دَعْوَتِیْ وَ اخْلُفْنِیْ فِیْمَنْ تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِیْ۔
